inputs.text:
### Reference Sheet Description
Top row (character): an anthropomorphic German Shepherd news anchor with brown, tan and black fur and thin round copper-framed glasses, shown in close-up and full-body front, three-quarter, side and back views, wearing a navy suit and red tie. Middle row (props): a silver desk microphone; a white coffee mug with a blue stripe. Bottom row (location): a modern newsroom desk with a glowing city-skyline backdrop.

### Target Description
Medium shot: the German Shepherd anchor sits at the newsroom desk, adjusts his glasses, leans toward the microphone and speaks to camera in a calm professional voice; the mug sits at his right hand. Static camera, soft studio lighting.
